Name: Content Patcher - Mermaid Statue
Author: seasIug
Description:
Replaces the Long Palm with a new mermaid statue in 4 colors, with optional algae, patina, and seasonal overlays.

It's recommended you use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url] to add the Long Palm into your game. It's a mid-late game item, and the only one which was tall enough for the sprite.

Thank you [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/177391248]otohimexoxo[/url] for encouraging me, and giving the idea to use the statue on the farm! The statue is for an upcoming bathhouse mod, but it's a long way from finished.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19809]Available for Alternative Textures[/url]!
